data.summary: Dynamic finance professional with 9 years of comprehensive experience in derivatives operations and trade support, currently serving as a Senior Associate. Expertise includes complex trade processing, fund reconciliation, and ensuring compliance with regulatory standards. Proven track record in automating workflows and enhancing operational efficiency through innovative solutions. Adept at managing a diverse range of financial products, including derivatives like TRS, CDS, and IRS, while facilitating accurate trade valuations and reconciliations. Strong collaborative skills developed through partnerships with front and middle office teams, and a commitment to training new personnel ensures seamless operations. Possesses a B.Com degree with proficiency in relevant tools such as TLM, Appian, and Ariba.

raw_sections.summary:
Objective
Dynamic finance professional with 9 years of comprehensive experience in derivatives operations and trade support, currently serving as a Senior Associate. Expertise includes complex trade processing, fund reconciliation, and ensuring compliance with regulatory standards. Proven track record in automating workflows and enhancing operational efficiency through innovative solutions. Adept at managing a diverse range of financial products, including derivatives like TRS, CDS, and IRS, while facilitating accurate trade valuations and reconciliations. Strong collaborative skills developed through partnerships with front and middle office teams, and a commitment to training new personnel ensures seamless operations. Possesses a B.Com degree with proficiency in relevant tools such as TLM, Appian, and Ariba.
raw_sections.experience:
Experience
ANZ
24 April 2025 - Till date (Contract) Senior Associate • Carry out basic and complex trade processing and valuation functions in accordance with established procedures and recording of margins for each fund. • Accounting vs. Custody reconciliation. • Review and post daily monthly NAV on accounting side. • Booking of derivative products (TRS, CDS, IRS etc) • Daily Mark to Market postings for funds into ledgers and reconciling with Broker statements and resolving Breaks • Verify Margins received in KSAF and make the postings to accounting. • Verify the price fluctuations of daily market prices and make adjustments in P&L statements by Staling prices if necessary and finally post the valuations on daily basis to fund accounting platform. • Reviewing/auditing periodical postings of corporate actions like dividends and bond interests. • Processing derivative trades sent by clients by setting up securities, recording of margins on daily basis and Pricing the Derivatives using Markit Platform. • Ensuring compliance with standard operating procedures and write new procedures where required. • Train new employees until they are prepared to handle function without oversight. • Respond to internal queries from Client Service teams.
Morgan Stanley
22 Jan 2024 - 12 March 2025 Contract • Part FID (Fixed Income Derivatives) and TSG (Trade support group) • Perform both Front office and Middle • Perform Reconciliation between Libra and DSL where analytical knowledge is applied to resolve the breaks by checking the booking of the trades with Broker details and various trade economics along with clearing team to resolve the breaks booking all the trades without any discrepancies. • As a part reconciling team with Trade level reconciliation of Up Stream and downstream and also along with Account and Cusip reconciliation as actioner method coordinate with trader, Broker and Clearing team so that all the 3 scenarios are inline. • Actively working with clearing team to accept the trades from the Broker in downstream so that there are no position breaks in upstream and downstream. • And deals with products Structured Notes, Bonds, Treasury Notes, IRS, Vanilla Products, and Cross Currency swap ect.
State Street Corporation Pvt Ltd
5th July 2021 - Nov, 2023 Senior Associate • Responsible for review/valuation and carry out basic and complex trades of Derivative. • Over the Counter Trades in accordance with established procedures – Specifically for Swap trades.that includes various products such as IRS, CDS, and TRS within the daily cut off time. Part of settlement of trade’s
activity that needs daily attention. • Analysing Cash breaks (Basically reconciling the trade posting of team and Custody entries) and clearing the breaks if any discrepancies by verifying, posting and rectifying the trades as required that are scenario based. • Respond to internal queries from Accounting or Client services. Respond to reconciliation breaks from internal recon teams regarding cash or position breaks. • Actively monitoring the email query with includes queries from Clients, Clearing team, Broker, Trades, Onshore.
Wells Fargo
Jan 2019 - June, 2021 Operations Accountant 1 - Analyzed financial statements for compliance with federal standards, ensuring accuracy and adherence to regulations. - Produced high-quality reports to support financial decision-making and maintain operational transparency. - Managed compliance with various accounting standards, including IFRS and US GAAP, across multiple business industries. - Conducted regular credit risk trigger monitoring through detailed covenant analysis, enhancing overall risk management strategies.
Accenture, Bangalore August 2016 - July 2018 Process Associate - Managed procurement processes including purchase order creation and quality checks. - Conducted analysis of quote requests and validated Purchase Receipts for approvals. - Oversaw end-to-end PR to PO operations ensuring timely deliveries.
